messages:
Ari: quick follow-up from the postmortem. we need concrete owners for headroom, autoscale tuning, quota backstops, and a recurring audit. keep replies brief.
Sam: i'll take autoscale tuning + scheduler knobs. short-term: add a per-node slot increase for micro-model traffic (8->11) behind a feature flag. ETA PR 2025-06-10.
Noor: i'll own quota backstops. plan: per-tenant token bucket + emergency throttle route and alerts. targeting PR 2025-06-08.
Ari: i'll own headroom proposal: baseline targets by cluster, routing policy to Dedicated, and cost delta. due 2025-06-12.
infra-bot: incident synopsis: 2025-06-01 02:05 UTC surge -> scheduler saturation + headroom starvation; peak GPU 98.5%; fallback rate 23%.
Sam: canary plan: 5% traffic for 2h, monitor gpu_utilization, scheduler_queue_len, preemption_rate, fallback_rate.
Noor: quota snippet:
```yaml
per_tenant:
  burst_tokens: 350
  refill_per_sec: 35
  max_concurrent: 160
alerts:
  sustained_pct: 68
```
Ari: recurring pattern note: headroom drift every ~3 weeks due to overlapping batch windows. propose weekly headroom audit in ops rotation.
opsbot: created task #CI-4120 "weekly-headroom-audit" assigned ops-rotation; first run 2025-06-14.
Sam: i'll add a smoke test for CI: 10m at 80% sustained load + 30m soak at 70%.
Noor: PR opened for token-bucket: https://git.internal/r/4129 - review ping @Sam @Ari
Sam: will open scheduler PR today and link canary dashboard panels.
Ari: once PRs merge we'll run verification windows (2h canary, 6h full rollout) and post results here.
opsbot: thread status set to "followups_scheduled"; reminders at 48h and 96h for owners.
Ari: thanks everyone. keep updates short and paste PR links. end of thread.
